name: Modern Lab
intro: You've been awarded a grant to 'fundamentally rethink circular mobility.' The committee loved the slide with the circle on it.

verdicts.text: This is a brick. Why is this a brick.

reviewer2: Reviewer 2 rejected your passing wheel: 'The authors fail to consider the square.'
Reviewer 2: 'Major revisions. Have you tried making it a triangle? Fewer bumps.'
Reviewer 2 requests you cite their 1987 paper on ovals. Rejected pending citation.
Reviewer 2: 'Novelty is limited. The wheel has been done before.' Fair, honestly.
drifts: BREAKING: ISO 31-0 has redefined 'round'. All previous wheels are now 'legacy round'.
A new paper shows wheels were never round, just very confident. Recalibrate.
The International Bureau of Circles has moved the reference circle 3 mm to the left.
Funding agency priorities changed. 'Round' now means 'round, but sustainable'.
